references.text: Here it is shown that weapons and violence are not the solution, which is also reflected in Moses' words about not killing.
Daniel predicts that kingdoms that rely on power and violence will eventually be destroyed, which resonates with Jesus' words.
The Hebrews are reminded that God's word is sharper than any double-edged sword, pointing to the power of spiritual weapons over physical ones.
Revelation warns that those who kill with the sword will be killed by the sword, which reflects Jesus' warning.
